name: Confidential badge
description: A bordered CONFIDENTIAL (or any) warning badge for the top right, with an optional second line.

params.name: text
params.help: The badge word, e.g. CONFIDENTIAL, INTERNAL, DRAFT, EMBARGOED

params.name: note
params.help: Small second line, e.g. Internal only, do not record (empty: none)

params.name: colour
params.help: Badge colour: red, amber, or the look's accent
